// THE INVERTED RULE: what the gate CANNOT follow is a FAILURE, not a pass.
//
// This is the rule that keeps the gate from going blind on a form nobody
// anticipated. A gate that silently skips the channel it could not trace is
// precisely the artifact stage 4b2 shipped: green, and wrong about the one class it
// existed to see.
//
// Two shapes, both flagged:
//   - a bus-delivered channel RETURNED out of the corpus, so its receive target is
//     decided somewhere this analysis never looks;
//   - a bus-delivered channel handed to a callee the gate cannot resolve.
package badunanalysable

const (
	signalActivityLeaseGranted   = "activityLeaseGranted"
	signalActivityLeaseRequested = "activityLeaseRequested"
)

func UnanalysableReturn(ctx workflow.Context) workflow.ReceiveChannel {
	ch := workflow.GetSignalChannel(ctx, signalActivityLeaseGranted)
	return ch // WANT: flagged — the gate cannot follow a channel out of the corpus
}

func UnanalysableHandOff(ctx workflow.Context) {
	ch := workflow.GetSignalChannel(ctx, signalActivityLeaseRequested)
	registerElsewhere(ch) // WANT: flagged — callee is not declared in this package
}
